# Pyae Thiri Cho (Jayanti)

> Junior Web Developer in Mandalay, Myanmar. Open to OJT / internship.

Junior web developer who builds web applications with Laravel, PHP and MySQL, and responsive front ends with HTML, CSS, JavaScript and Bootstrap. I enjoy turning ideas into clean, user-friendly products, from online shops to admin dashboards.

## Skills

HTML5, CSS3, Bootstrap, JavaScript, React, PHP, Laravel, MySQL

## Projects

- [Myanmar Handicrafts System](https://github.com/PyaeThiriCho/handicrafts): A Laravel shop for Myanmar handicrafts. Customers browse, order and pay by KPay, Wave or cash on delivery, and admins manage stock and orders. Built with PHP, Laravel, MySQL, Bootstrap.
- [Online Book Shop](https://github.com/PyaeThiriCho/laravelbookshopproject): A Laravel bookshop where customers browse books, fill a cart and check out, and the owner manages books, authors, categories and orders. Built with PHP, Laravel, MySQL, Bootstrap.
- [Rosiva Flower Shop](https://github.com/PyaeThiriCho/rosivaflowershop): A Laravel flower shop with a catalog you can browse by category and occasion, a cart, and an admin dashboard for products and images. Built with PHP, Laravel, MySQL, Bootstrap.
- [Gym Management Admin Panel](https://github.com/PyaeThiriCho/gym-): A Laravel admin panel for a gym to manage members, classes, staff users and role-based permissions. Built with PHP, Laravel, MySQL, Bootstrap.

## Experience

- Web Developer Intern at Wisdom (2025): Built and maintained responsive pages for client websites. Developed Laravel features connected to MySQL databases. Fixed layout bugs and improved page load speed.
